description:
Electrical interconnection/wiring sheet for two labelled connector/device groups, BEL1-S and BEL2-S. No breaker, fuse, switch, contactor, relay, PLC output, protective-device identifier, or protective-device rating is shown on this sheet; therefore no upstream overcurrent-protective device can be assigned without guessing. The only lines explicitly named as supplies are G3-S3S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY for BEL1-S and G3-S4S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY for BEL2-S; their upstream source/protection is not identified here. Likewise, VBATTERY RTN and CANA_Shield are returns/shields, and SYNC/CHAIN_OUTPUT lines are signal/interconnect conductors rather than separately identified power feeds.

BEL1-S connector/device group (left half): printed pin/function mapping is I/O pin 2 = G3-S3S1 FREQ_SELECT; pin 7 = G3-S3R1 VBATTERY RTN; pin 11 = G3-S321 CHAIN_OUTPUT; pin 3 = G3-S3S2 SYNC; pin 1 = G3-S329 ENABLE, with the far end marked N/C; pin 8 = G3-S300a ADR_0, far end N/C; pin 9 = G3-S300b ADR_1, far end N/C; pin 5 = G3-S3AH CANA_HI; pin 6 = G3-S3AL CANA_LO; connector position N/C = G3-S3AS CANA_Shield; the remaining printed connector positions are 10 and 4, with G3-S3S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY printed adjacent to this portion of the connector. The upper interconnects are a BEL/RTN1 connector, a SYNC connector with terminals 10 and 3, and a CAN-A connector with Shield, HI, and LO. The drawing shows the SYNC conductors as a twisted pair and CANA_HI/CANA_LO as a twisted pair within a shield; CANA_Shield is distinct from the two data conductors. G3-S3R1 SYNC RTN is explicitly named on the return/synchronization run. FREQ_SELECT and ENABLE are the only explicitly named control/configuration points in this group; ADR_0 and ADR_1 are address/configuration signals, while CHAIN_OUTPUT, SYNC, CANA_HI, and CANA_LO are signal/interconnect lines. No local switch, panel switch, relay, PLC output, or alarm/monitoring tap is identified by readable label on this sheet.

BEL2-S connector/device group (right half): printed pin/function mapping is I/O pin 2 = G3-S4S1 FREQ_SELECT; pin 7 = G3-S4R1 VBATTERY RTN; pin 11 = G3-S421 CHAIN_OUTPUT; pin 3 = G3-S4S2 SYNC; pin 1 = G3-S429 ENABLE, with the far end marked N/C; pin 8 = G3-S400a ADR_0, far end N/C; pin 9 = G3-S400b ADR_1, far end N/C; pin 5 = G3-S4AH CANA_HI; pin 6 = G3-S4AL CANA_LO; connector position N/C = G3-S4AS CANA_Shield; the remaining printed connector positions are 10 and 4, with G3-S4S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY printed adjacent to this portion of the connector. The upper interconnects are a BEL/RTN1 connector, a SYNC connector with terminals 9 and 4, and a CAN-A connector with Shield, HI, and LO. The drawing shows the SYNC conductors as a twisted pair and CANA_HI/CANA_LO as a twisted pair within a shield; CANA_Shield is distinct from the data conductors. G3-S4R1 SYNC_RTN is explicitly named on the return/synchronization run. FREQ_SELECT and ENABLE are explicitly named control/configuration points; ADR_0 and ADR_1 are address/configuration signals, while CHAIN_OUTPUT, SYNC, CANA_HI, and CANA_LO are signal/interconnect lines. No local switch, panel switch, relay, PLC output, or alarm/monitoring tap is identified by readable label on this sheet.

Topology stated conservatively from the sheet: each BELx-S connector exposes CHAIN_SUPPLY and VBATTERY RTN together with frequency-select, enable, address, synchronization, chain-output, and CAN-A interconnects. The upper BEL/RTN1, SYNC, and CAN-A blocks are connector continuations; the sheet does not identify the ultimate powered load type (pump, valve, light, etc.) or the upstream protective device. N/C markings are preserved and must not be treated as connected controls. Cross-reference visible in the title block: WARNING: EXPORT CONTROLLED - SEE TITLE PAGE. The border/title information identifies 1905D023 and sheet 2; no readable 'see DWG' or other circuit continuation reference is present.
